description: Three purple columbine flowers with white central petals populate the composition. The center flower is in full bloom, while the other two are partially opened. Delicate white flowers that resemble lily of the valley, drawn in pencil, dangle from thin stems surrounding the columbine blooms. The plants are set against a plain white background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Flowers)
